Ford Transit 2018 – Commercial Decals and Lettering

When you’re starting a new business or rebranding an existing one, it goes without saying that you need to spread the word. To make sure people know about your business or the changes you’ve made, you need to take every opportunity and put forth your brand for people to see and start recognizing it.

Now, what you don’t want to do is invest in something that annoys people rather than something that efficiently shows off your brand and services.

Having been our long-time returning client, Mr. Takar has seen what kind of advertising works for a business. In the past, we’ve provided Mr. Takar with corporate apparel decorated with his company logo as well as installed promotional decals on his company fleet vehicles. If you’d like to see more van wraps, click here.

To Keep up with the current times and trends, our client decided to rebrand his business from Aeroparks to Aerospot. Changing the name can have a huge impact on a company because the company now has a completely different name. If a business changes its name and does not make an effort to make it known to the general public, it can cause the following:

  • Loss of clients due to the sudden rebranding.
  • May cause the clients to lose faith in the company’s authenticity because it changed names and made no announcement about it.
  • Lose online traffic because people are still searching with the old company name.

To make sure none of the above happens, our client contacted us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto to get promotional decals on two of his fleet vehicles.

Our graphic design team designed the company’s new logo so it made sense to the client that we should be the ones designing custom decals and lettering to show off his rebranded business.

The client wanted the same style and colours for the new decals as he had in the past prior to rebranding his business. Our design team rendered the mockups showing what the decals and lettering would look like on the van.

However, what we see on a screen or paper isn’t necessarily what we get in reality. After we installed the decals on one of the van’s windows the client came in to take a look. He felt the brand name is getting lost or isn’t popping enough to grab someone’s attention due to the glass background. So, we relocated the decals and lettering where they can be clearly seen.

The decals were installed all around the two Ford Transits to make sure they show off the business logo from every direction. We used premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison. The colours the client picked, were:

  • Gloss Orange SW900-373
  • Gloss Dark Blue SW900-681

We’ve attached pictures of the vehicles after getting the promotional decals and lettering for you to see how an ordinary vehicle can be your company’s moving billboard.

Also, check out

  • Benefits of getting decals
  • Tips to get the most out of your promotional company decals
